summary: Whether you show it or not, a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control grind against each other inside you. That friction is the engine you run on. Pushed, you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline. Owned, you imagine, feel for others, and create and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.

gift: At your best: you imagine, feel for others, and create, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you escape, idealize, or lose your own outline - or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let imagination and longing and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Generational and collective; minimal personal day-to-day meaning.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you imagine, feel for others, and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
